scope: Actual WASM UI and IndexedDB; read-only renderer snapshots; mobile viewport emulation, not physical iPhone.

steps.name: real Classic expedition boots with native equipment and abilities
all10 assignment slots are readable and assignment replacement is free
closing nested assignment and throw-style menus releases the native panel without a turn
equipment chooses an explicit hand and cancellation preserves ownership
direction buttons select a heading from the actor and preview cancellation is free

preview.name: Jet Blast
preview.details:
Jet Blast

Cone 2: soaks and shoves. Sets up lightning.

Range: 2 cells.
Targeting: one of eight directions; shape and interception as described above.
Cooldown: 20 turns after successful use.

Learning: Already learned.
Required tree: Hydromancy.

Ready: off cooldown.

steps.name: opening Pack from the keyboard clears aim and closing it cannot revive stale targeting
body and ground throw previews remain distinct at the same visible body

previews.description: Body: Yevven Wethand, warden / 1 item / 1 action. First contact: Yevven Wethand, warden; rests at [36,16]. Friendly/neutral contact: effects still apply.
Ground / 1 item / 1 action. First contact: Yevven Wethand, warden; rests at [36,16]. Friendly/neutral contact: effects still apply.

steps.name: one explicit ability confirmation commits exactly one native turn
cooldown abilities remain inspectable and assignable without another turn
checkpoint persists the actual assignments and equipment
